name: 列車 × 電波
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: square desktop application icon candidate for a Japanese conventional railway digital radio receiver, Rust/Tauri application. Generate exactly ONE polished icon, no comparison sheet, no surrounding UI. Style: precise, restrained geometric flat graphic with immaculate curves and confident thick shapes, comparable to a professionally designed macOS / Windows utility icon; visually clear when reduced to 32 pixels. A deep navy #141e28 rounded-square tile centered on a genuinely transparent canvas, tile occupies 88% of canvas width and height, generous consistent interior padding. Palette matches the actual application's dark UI: navy #141e28, mint #72dfc1, ivory #e5edf3, optional pale blue #9bcaff. Almost entirely flat, subtle surface depth at most. Strong simple silhouette, two or three main visual components maximum. No text, no letters, no numbers, no JR logo, no watermark, no photographic details, no hairline strokes, no neon glow, no drop shadow outside tile. Square high-resolution image.
Primary request: communicate railway radio reception immediately. Main subject: a beautifully simplified front-facing Japanese conventional commuter train in ivory, centered in lower-middle of the navy tile. Rounded rectangular cab silhouette, broad dark windshield with one central divider, two small simple mint headlights, short understated undercarriage. Above the train roof, two substantial nested mint radio reception arcs, concentric and perfectly balanced. A small intentional gap separates train roof and arcs. The train is a compact commuter train, not a streamlined bullet train. Elegant app icon, memorable and extremely readable, not a detailed train illustration.
